==Description==
'''Spin Wheel''' is a wheel that can be spun for a random reward. It requires {{SpinTicket|Spin Tickets}} to activate. When the '''Spin Wheel''' stops, it can land on one of eight spots, each with its own reward and chance of being selected. Items change every time it is spun.

==Tickets==
{{SpinTicket|Spin Tickets}} are the currency used to spin the wheel. These can be obtained through gameplay via [[Login Rewards]], [[Playtime Rewards]] and triumphs, or they can be purchased directly for {{Robux|49}}. However, due to gambling laws, players are unable to use Robux to buy {{SpinTicket|Spin Tickets}} if they are located in the Netherlands, Australia, or Belgium. Additionally, players in the United Kingdom and Brazil who cannot verify their age to be over 18 are also restricted from purchasing tickets with  {{Robux|Robux}}. The '''Spin Wheel''' will not appear for people in these countries.

{{SpinTicket|Spin Tickets}} take the appearance of a golden ticket with a wheel on them.
